name: Compute EOG artifact SSP projectors
summary: Compute SSP (signal-space projection) vectors for EOG artifacts.
description: Detects EOG (blink and eye-movement) events in continuous MEG/EEG data and computes SSP projectors for them with mne.preprocessing.compute_proj_eog, then saves the projectors, topomap and EOG-evoked figures and an HTML report. Use it to build EOG projectors to apply in later preprocessing. As noted in the README, main.py reads a qrs_threshold key that is not a registered parameter and passes it to compute_proj_eog, which has no such argument, so runs are expected to fail until this is fixed.

inputs.description: Continuous MEG/EEG recording in MNE raw .fif format, with an EOG channel or a channel named by ch_name.

outputs.description: SSP projector computed based on EOG.
Topomap of the EOG projectors (eog_projectors.png) and EOG-evoked joint plots (eog_*.png).

Can be ‘separate’ (default) or ‘combined’ to compute projectors for magnetometers and gradiometers separately or jointly. If ‘combined’, n_mag == n_grad is required and the number of projectors computed for MEG will be n_mag.
Dictionary of parameters to use for IIR filtering. See mne.filter.construct_iir_filter for details. If iir_params is None and method=”iir”, 4th order Butterworth will be used.
